column3: Saori Route ・ Friends Without Spiral Glasses
After that, a few days passed.
Today is the first day of Comiket.
Kirino and I went to play around at Kuroneko's circle space...
Or rather, went to look at Kuroneko's wares.
Saori was... not there.
Giving in to her fiancé's request, she gave up being an otaku.
The community of "Otaku Girls Unite!" that Saori created is no more.
Or it was on the verge of disappearing, when Kirino and Kuroneko were entrusted with running it.
Of course, her fiancé apparently had made her cut ties with Kirino, Kuroneko, and I.
Or so it seemed.
Oh yeah! The black one brought those books that don't sell at all again. It's about time she learns, right?
Could you not be so jealous that these books are too good for their comprehension?
Well, it is not as if I had expected you to understand.
Huh? I don't wanna understand those garbage books, anyway...
fufufu... Do you really think those words will work on me?
You should bathe in the mid-summer flames of purgatory and burn out your soul.
Wait, can you hear, Saori? That black one is sending radio waves out of her head again.
...Hand me the phone. I have something I want to say...
Why don't you use that telepathy of yours?
Don't talk of telepathy as some sort of conversation device. It is an induction of souls only given to the chosen ones.
Well...
Even though it's been like this a lot lately, we've been keeping in touch.
Even if we get separated, our hearts are connected.
Isn't that what it means to be friends?
...I still can't really accept this, though...
